objective: Diagnose the 11,602-object CPVS candidate excess with source-backed object-level evidence while preserving the v0.2.0 scientific baseline.
expected_improvement: Obtain a reproducible, source-backed explanation for the CPVS membership discrepancy without weakening scientific acceptance criteria.

reconstructed_candidate_count.note: Historical empirical filtering result only; not yet established as the authors' intended rule.

published_reference_count.note: Reference catalogue count; membership semantics remain under validation.

evidence: GitHub Actions run 40966809678: Format Check and Lint passed.
GitHub Actions run 40966809678: direct 17-object audit downloaded Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.5764899 and verified the published MD5.

GitHub Actions run 40966809678: direct audit failed before membership comparison because its VizieR parser never recognized the data header; all 17 IDs reported missing are therefore not membership results.
validation.blocker: The corrected VizieR header parser must be executed and the 17-object SourceID-to-reference membership result verified. The full 11,602-object discrepancy remains unresolved.

root_causes: The targeted CI script incorrectly expected a single #Column metadata line to contain both ID and Seq; VizieR emits one metadata line per column followed by a separate tab-delimited data header.
The prior failure to map all 17 IDs is an audit-script parsing failure and must not be interpreted as evidence of reference non-membership.
The scientific cause of the 11,602 candidate excess is not yet proven.

findings: A failed ID crosswalk can arise before any membership comparison; the audit must validate its parsed schema before reporting per-object membership.
A successful Zenodo checksum verifies downloaded bytes, not the correctness of the object-level crosswalk or scientific interpretation.
The reconstruction and production scientific gates must remain blocked until full membership and provenance evidence are independently verified.

open_blockers: Re-run the corrected direct 17-object audit and inspect the uploaded per-object JSON.
Reproduce the comparison for all 11,602 candidate-only IDs and establish the root cause.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not interpret a parser failure as membership evidence.
Do not alter the production selector, thresholds, model, or acceptance criteria to force a match.
